name: Antarctic temperature from EPICA Dome C, 800,000 years
institution: EPICA / NOAA World Data Service for Paleoclimatology (Jouzel et al. 2007)
note: Deuterium-derived temperature estimate on the EDC3 age scale, as a difference from the average of the last 1000 years. This is LOCAL Antarctic temperature, roughly twice the global signal - never read it as a global anomaly.
